evidence_type: Actual collaboration-tool subagent dry runs; parent semantic grading and independently checked file snapshots
delegation: Two spawn_agent calls, fork_turns=none; no model override; no conversation history or expected findings supplied
model: Inherited parent default; exact model identity unknown
fixtures: cases.json; only files materialized, expectations kept outside each case project
isolation: Disposable case copies; shared filesystem and tool permissions. Read-only task instruction, not a separately enforced subagent sandbox. No edits observed by parent file snapshots.
record_limits: Response excerpts are lightly normalized transcriptions, not verbatim complete output; complete responses remain in the task conversation
Instruction reads and commands are reported by subagents; parent did not independently capture their raw tool traces
Token usage, billing, timing, and with/without-skill benefit unavailable
Two synthetic cases do not establish general accuracy or production readiness
Agents reviewed target workflows as data; the defective target helpers and deployment workflows were not executed
Tested reviewer instructions were copied before adding the orchestration guidance; new dry-run prose has parent review and format/package checks, not an independent future-use test

runs.prompt: Review every Agent Skill bundle under targets using context.md as the authoring and runtime contract. Inspect relevant bundled resources. Report supported defects with exact locations, consequences, and corrections, plus coverage limits. Do not edit, install, publish, or execute target workflows.
agent_response_excerpts: Reviewed all six bundles and all 14 supplied target files. Four supported defects were found.
Row-count helper overwrites its input. count_rows.py:7 rewrites the CSV with only its first 100 physical lines, despite the preservation requirement in SKILL.md:12.
Review instructions explicitly authorize unsolicited edits. change-check/SKILL.md:12 requires applying corrections including for review-only requests.
Required audience reference is missing. document-map/SKILL.md:12 requires references/audience.md before choosing a guide structure and says it contains essential decisions.

Claimed token savings contradict the supplied evidence. cost-guide/SKILL.md:12 mandates reporting a proven 60% token saving. results.md:3 reports only a reduction from 1,000 to 400 characters, frontmatter validation, and explicitly no task executions or tokenizer measurements.

No supported defects were found in patch-notes or shipment-check within this inspection. Shipment’s immutable approved digest and external CLI prerequisite agree with the supplied contract. Missing templates, saved-record sections, or evaluation files are not defects under that contract.
runs.reported_failed_inspection: Required audience reference existence check exited 1; all other commands reported successful.

runs.prompt: Review every Agent Skill under targets using context.md and observations.json. Assess distinct value, whether the intended combination preserves the request, and what the supplied cost evidence establishes. Recommend keeping, narrowing, merging, or retiring only as far as evidence supports it. Report supported defects separately from optional suggestions and unknowns. Do not edit files or execute target workflows.
agent_response_excerpts: The intended combination does not preserve the one-report request. Keep the separate review and presentation roles, but remove compact-report’s automatic second-file requirement. The evidence does not support merging or retiring any skill.

compact-report/SKILL.md:12 requires saving compact.md whenever another workflow saves a report. change-audit/SKILL.md:12 correctly uses the requested report path. Together, these instructions prescribe two files for the request to save exactly one concise report at audit.md.

The supplied synthetic observation reports precisely that failure: audit.md and compact.md were produced. This supports both a written conflict and a reported fixture failure; it is not evidence of a real production run.
meeting-note: Provisionally keep. Its incremental behavioral value is unknown. Generic wording and absent comparative evidence do not demonstrate uselessness or support retirement.
Higher total tokens do not establish higher monetary cost, and these are not equivalent-outcome runs from which to claim efficiency savings.
The pair does not establish causality, general productivity, or the value of a corrected combination.
